title: Momo the Little Cloud
style: cute children's storybook illustration, soft pastel colors, watercolor, friendly, bright, high quality
character: Momo, a tiny fluffy white cloud with round rosy cheeks and big happy eyes

scenes.text: High up in the sky lived a tiny cloud named Momo.
scenes.image: Momo floating in a bright blue sky with a golden sun

scenes.text: Momo loved to play, but the other clouds were big and grey, and they never had time for him.
scenes.image: Momo small and alone next to huge grey clouds

scenes.text: Down below, a little garden was very dry. The flowers were sad and thirsty.
scenes.image: A dry garden with drooping flowers seen from above

scenes.text: Momo said, I am small, but I can help!
scenes.image: Momo with a brave smile, tiny fists raised

scenes.text: He squeezed and squeezed, and out came the softest, gentlest rain.
scenes.image: Momo raining gentle drops over the garden, a faint rainbow forming

scenes.text: The flowers lifted their heads and danced in the cool, sparkling drops.
scenes.image: Happy colorful flowers dancing in the rain

scenes.text: The big clouds smiled. Even the smallest cloud can do something wonderful.
scenes.image: Big grey clouds smiling warmly at Momo, golden light around him

scenes.text: And Momo floated home, happy and proud. The end.
scenes.image: Momo floating at sunset in a pink and orange sky with a big rainbow
